notes.title: UPDATE: DEMO Ver 1.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Updated character avatars.
[*]Enhanced the balance of the combat system and improved the AI of both enemies and allies.
[*]Adjusted the storyline of some levels and added new content.
[*]When picking up dropped items from enemies, they won't disappear if the player reaches the maximum capacity, allowing time for adjustment.
[*]Redesigned the treasure chest system, optimizing item categorization and quantity control.
[*]Bug fixes and overall improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.662
notes.content:
Dear friends, I hope you all had a amazing day! Anyway.

Note: This update may break your old saves. A fresh start is recommended.


[list]
[*] Mary dies will no longer trigger a Game Over: 
So this is a major one. Because I think it is kind of a waste to simply make this rather long part of the game an "escort mission". Instead, now players can try all sort of party combat tricks and even develope their own strategies without holding back. 
[*] Mary can roll now!
[*] Mary can use crossbow now!
[*] Weapon/Armor/Accessory menu now shows item info even when it is equipted by player.
[*] You can now craft new equipment without removing it from your character.
[*] Party member will revive with 100% HP now.
[*] Fixed/Changed many items's descriptions and make it more clear for players to understand how to use them.
[*] Adjusted Banfield's Exp curve.
[*] You can now enter a "Training Map" to practice various action skills via game menu-> "Control".
[*] Fixed the hit box of underground mini boss's "evil baby bomb".
[*] Many small fixes and adjustments to UI and map details.
[/list]

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.65
notes.content:
Dear friends, 

[list]
[*] New sprites for the underground mini boss
[*] Underground mini boss rebalanced and updated attack animations
[*] Added a Workbench in the underground mini boss level, so that player can craft a new set of armor there after defeating the boss
[*] Some items relocated to provide better experience
[*] Sfx changes and new OST
[/list]

Thank you all for supporting this game.
I wish you have a nice day!

notes.title: Mnstronium Demo Ver 1.62
notes.content:
Hi, dear friends! Some small but important changes have been made into the latest version of this Demo.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Mary will ask you twice the same question after defeating the Cult boss
[*] Fixed a bug the "special service" still charge you even when you already had a "service"
[*]When you come out of that "special service" house, Mary will join you automatically
[*] Difficulty level change will not affect enemy's HP now as it is not working as intented
[*] Some enemies, such as Slim, are now passive, you will get hurt only when you step on them
[*] Give player warnings when they try to wander into deep part of the map too early in game
[*] Menu can adjust position to avoid being disrupted
[*] A new Ally action tutorial section is added
[*] Adjusted some doll house's enemies parameters, as a test
[*] Added a new background music for the woods
[/list]

Overall, this update is meant to give some quality of life experiences to those players who really need/want them. But they are completely optional. 

Thank you! Have a nice day.

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.6
notes.content:
Hi, this one is not easy. Since it changed some game logic events, it may break your old saves or some odd things may happen at some point. But the changes are necessary so I'm sorry!

Main changes:

If you went to the mill and triggered the event there, before you find the car, then when you (if you are strong and lucky enough of course) finished that part of the story, you will encounter a new cutscene and
you will be able to easily pick up your progress from there. 

Removed some blocking characters and make it fully free for anyone who dare to explore the map instead of finding the car first, try your best to defeat enemies. 

The Spin attack consume less SP now. But also reduced its power and range.

This update could break your old saves.

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.55 Update
notes.content:
Dear friends, 

[list]
[*] Adjusted player hit box: Spin Sword attack (charge attack) is no longer OP.
[*] Mary's attack hit box adjuested and power re-balanced (still powerful, but...)
[*] Adjusted some bosses.
[*] New attack move set for a mini boss.
[*] Fixed a bug where follower's HP is not updated on screen in real time. 
[*] Fixed a bug in the 'Ally Auto Heal' function, where if your ally's HP is already below 33% when it is turned on, it will only work after you switch character once. It is fixed now. 
[*] The game difficulty level option is now affecting enemy's HP as well as their other powers.
If you set the difficult level below 100% (middle), you will not gain any EXP by killing monsters.
You can change this setting anytime. This is still a test for this demo only. 
[*] Added a few navigation waypoints to the map.
[*] Original music work.
[*] Other minor fixes and changes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jRMl3e_vTAE

Thank you and have a nice day!

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.5 Update
notes.content:
Dear friends, 

Here are some of the changes that have been made into the latest version of this demo:

[list]
[*] Changed many SFX from RTP placeholder to original materials
[*] Changed how Mary fight in the Doll House, to avoid a potential soft-locking bug
[*] Fixed some transportation point detection bugs
[*] Have access to a workbench early in the game in order to craft rings
[*] Enemy re-balance adjustment
[*] Menu function updates (give warning message when discard items, weapons and accessories, etc)
[*]Changed some animation effects
[/list]

Oh, by the way, the well leads to a castle, that is a good thing to have ;-)

Thank you all!

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.4 Update
notes.content:
Some changes have been made into the game based on feedbacks from our testers.

[list]
[*] Fullscreen works with dual-monitor setup now, allowing mouse to be used in other applications while playing the game

[*] Some cutscenes are added to the game to give better focus on your mission and not get lost

[*] A descriptions for each parameter when leveling up, so you know exactly what is affecting what

[*] Added a little bit more loot to make your life slightly easier ;-)

[*] Enemy balancing

[*] Changed some keyboard key bindings, also updated the controller layout image accordingly

[*] No more 'Marry'
[/list]



I will keep working on things that will make your gaming experience as intuitive and enjoyable as possible.  Maybe I will make crafting notes visble by player in game menu, I don't know now, because that is kinda unnecessary, since you will only need it when you craft an item that needs it and it will show up for you. I will think a better way to deal with that, maybe.  

Anyway, thank you for your time, have a nice day!

notes.title: Monstronium Demo Ver 1.3 Update
notes.content:
Hello there, this is a small update for the Monstronium Demo.

Changelog:

Removed the in game full screen setting option.
Now the game uses defult Alt + Enter to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.

[b]Note[/b] that on Steam Deck, this is not affected. As Steam Deck will always in fullscreen mode.
Only use this when you are playing in Windows, and you are not automatically in fullscreen mode.



Thank you and have a nice day!

notes.title: Demo Ver 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hello there! 
Monstronium Demo Ver 1.2 is out.

Changes:
 
Tutorial stage now have a dedicated section for "bloking" technique, which is essential for new players.
Some fix and adjustment to tutorial texts, make it more clear and intuitive.
Reduced training droids HP.
Added a mini tutorial for moving objects in Figus's workshop.
Lowered some sound effects for certain enemies.

Thank you!

notes.title: MONSTRONIUM Demo is live
notes.content:
Dear friends,

The MONSTRONIUM demo is now officially available for download on the Steam store.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1891510/Monstronium/
Here is a brief overview of the demo:

[list]
[*] Approximately 2 to 4 hours of main storyline content
[*] Includes a multi-ending story
[*] Various types of monsters and challenging boss battles
[*] Detailed and captivating map designs
[*] Multiple original music tracks
[*] Fully supported on WINDOWS 10/11 and STEAM OS operating systems
[*] Fully supported with controllers*, making it perfect for playing on PC handhelds and STEAM DECK
[*] Currently available in English and Chinese.
[/list]

*Tested with original Xbox One and Xbox 360 gamepad
